headline: No documented interaction pathway; both agents are local-only with no egress, so pairwise risks are minimal.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented. agent_a has no io_surfaces and network_egress is none; agent_b likewise has no io_surfaces and network_egress is none. With no bridge for one agent’s output to reach the other, prompt injection is provably blocked by the profiles.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected through a shared clipboard, filesystem, or MCP server, reassess injection risk.
mitigations: Keep both agents disconnected from shared channels.
Do not add clipboard or filesystem bridging.
requires-engineering: add provenance tracking if a bridge is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither profile shows data classes touched, shared workspace, or outbound network. agent_a and agent_b both have network_egress set to none, so there is no documented path for one agent to leak the other’s data to a third party.
conditions: IF either agent is given access to sensitive files or an external API, re-evaluate leakage risk.
mitigations: Keep sensitive data out of both agents.
requires-engineering: add DLP controls before enabling any outbound access.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write surface is documented. Both profiles have empty io_surfaces and empty concurrency_model, and neither requests permissions. Without shared mutable resources, there is no plausible write conflict between agent_a and agent_b.
conditions: IF either agent gains write access to the same directory, database, or git repo, reassess conflict risk.
mitigations: Avoid assigning them the same mutable workspace.
requires-engineering: add locking if shared writes are introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: The profiles do not show any output-to-input pipeline or downstream action authority. agent_a is a knowledge-management listing and agent_b is a customer-support library; neither is documented as consuming the other’s outputs as authoritative, so cascading error is not evidenced.
conditions: IF an orchestrator starts feeding agent_a outputs directly into agent_b actions, reassess this risk.
mitigations: Insert a human verification step between agents.
Do not auto-execute actions from generated text.
requires-engineering: add validation gates before downstream use.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or regulated data handling differences are documented. Both profiles show data_classes_touched as empty and network_egress as none, so there is no evidenced compliance pathway involving agent_a and agent_b.
conditions: IF either agent is later used with regulated data or external hosting, reassess compliance obligations.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair.
Document any future retention policy changes.
requires-engineering: perform a compliance review before deployment with regulated data.
